author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಜ್ಞಾನಿಯೆಂದೆನ್ನುವರು ತನ್ನತಾನರಿವವಗೆ
ಹಾನಿಮಾಡದೆನಡೆವಾತ್ಮ ಗೌರವಕೆ
ಗ್ಲಾನಿಯಾಗಿಹ ಚಿತ್ತ ತನ್ನತನ ಹುಡುಕುತಿರೆ
ಮ್ಲಾನವನು ತೊರೆದುನಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: They call one wise who knows himself,
who walks without harming his own self-respect;
when a weary mind keeps searching for its true self,
walk on, leaving gloom behind, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Wisdom is knowing yourself and keeping your dignity. When a tired mind is searching for who it is, leave despondency behind and keep going.
